mapper.insert: insert into house_hot_daily_stats ( house_id, city, stat_date, browse_count, favorite_count, consult_count, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{houseId}, #{city}, #{statDate}, #{browseDelta}, #{favoriteDelta}, #{consultDelta}, now(), now() ) on duplicate key update city = values(city), browse_count = greatest(0, browse_count + values(browse_count)), favorite_count = greatest(0, favorite_count + values(favorite_count)), consult_count = greatest(0, consult_count + values(consult_count)), update_time = now()
mapper.select: select house_id as houseId, sum(browse_count) as recentBrowseCount, sum(favorite_count) as recentFavoriteCount, sum(consult_count) as recentConsultCount from house_hot_daily_stats where city = #{city} and stat_date >= #{startDate} group by house_id
